title: Steering Visual Generation in Unified Multimodal Models with Understanding Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2605.05781v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Unified multimodal models are envisioned to bridge the gap between understanding and generation. Yet, to achieve competitive performance, state-of-the-art models adopt largely decoupled understanding and generation components. This design, while effective for individual tasks, weakens the connection required for mutual enhancement, leaving the potential synergy empirically uncertain. We propose to explicitly restore this synergy by introducing Understanding-Oriented Post-Training (UNO), a lightweight framework that treats understanding not only as a distinct task, but also a direct supervisory signal to steer generative representations. By incorporating objectives that encode semantic abstraction (captioning) and structural details (visual regression), we enable effective gradient flow from understanding to generation. translated_title: 利用理解监督引导统一多模态模型中的视觉生成
translated_abstract: 统一多模态模型旨在弥合理解与生成之间的鸿沟。然而，为了取得具有竞争力的性能，最先进的模型采用了在很大程度上解耦的理解与生成组件。这种设计虽然对单项任务有效，却削弱了实现相互增强所需的联系，使得这种潜在的协同效应在实证层面尚不确定。我们提出通过引入面向理解的后训练框架UNO来显式恢复这种协同作用。该轻量级框架不仅将理解视为一项独立任务，还将其作为直接监督信号来引导生成表征。通过引入编码语义抽象（图像描述）和结构细节（视觉回归）的训练目标，我们实现了从理解到生成的有效梯度流动。在图像生成和编辑任务上的大量实验表明，理解可以作为一种有效的……
tldr: 提出轻量级后训练框架UNO，将理解任务作为直接监督信号引导生成表征，从而在统一多模态模型中显式恢复理解与生成之间的协同增效。
en_tdlr: UNO is a lightweight post-training framework that leverages understanding tasks as direct supervisory signals to steer generative representations, explicitly restoring the synergy between understanding and generation in unified multimodal models.
